text.zh-CN:
脑膜炎是覆盖脑和脊髓的保护膜发生炎症，常由感染引起。

- 常见表现是发热、头痛、颈部僵硬，可能伴呕吐、怕光或意识变化；婴儿表现可能很不典型。
- 本页按病因分流：细菌、病毒、真菌和结核等类型的治疗不同。结核属于细菌感染，但需专门的抗结核方案；医生通过检查确定病因，不能仅凭症状轻重分类。
- 这里也包括肠道病毒性脑膜炎和流感嗜血杆菌性脑膜炎。流感嗜血杆菌是细菌，有不同类型；Hib只是其中的b型，不能用Hib代表全部流感嗜血杆菌感染。
- “其他特指”表示医生已指出某种病因，但不属于列表里单独列出的类型；它不是一种统一的病原体，也不同于尚未查明原因。处理仍按细菌、病毒、真菌、寄生虫及具体病原分流。
text.en:
Meningitis is inflammation of the protective membranes around the brain and spinal cord, commonly caused by infection.

- Typical features are fever, headache and neck stiffness, sometimes with vomiting, light sensitivity or altered awareness; infants may present differently.
- This overview separates causes: bacterial, viral, fungal and tuberculous meningitis require different treatment. Tuberculosis is bacterial but needs a specific anti-TB regimen; testing establishes the cause, rather than symptom severity alone.
- This page also covers enteroviral meningitis and meningitis caused by Haemophilus influenzae. H. influenzae is a bacterium with several types; Hib is only type b and does not represent every H. influenzae infection.
- Other specified denotes a cause identified by the clinician that is not a separately listed type. It is not one uniform organism and differs from an unknown cause. Care still follows the bacterial, viral, fungal, parasitic and organism-specific pathways.

text.zh-CN:
不同病原体的进入途径和易感人群不同，也存在由药物、自身免疫病或癌症等引起的非感染性脑膜炎。

- 部分细菌可通过近距离呼吸道分泌物或唾液接触传播，例如亲吻；携带者可能没有症状。
- 病毒性脑膜炎患者的接触者可能感染同一种病毒，但多数不会因此发生脑膜炎。
- 新生儿、免疫功能低下者、没有脾脏或脾功能异常者，以及某些集体居住人群，发生特定细菌感染的风险较高；不同人群易感染的细菌并不相同。
- 真菌性脑膜炎通常不在人与人之间传播，免疫功能低下者更容易患病。
- 肠道病毒是一组病毒，可通过感染者的粪便、唾液或呼吸道分泌物，以及被污染的手和物品传播。感染肠道病毒不等于一定患脑膜炎。
- 链球菌不是单一细菌：B族链球菌更常见于新生儿，肺炎链球菌也可感染较大儿童和成人。葡萄球菌、部分革兰阴性菌则需结合头部外伤、神经外科手术、分流管或其他感染来源判断。
- 腺病毒通常引起呼吸道、眼部或胃肠道感染，少数累及神经系统；免疫功能低下者更容易出现重症。不能因为同时流鼻涕或腹泻，就否认脑膜炎的可能。
- 真菌也可能通过受污染的脊柱注射或医疗操作进入体内，健康人同样可能受影响；症状可能缓慢出现。真菌种类和暴露地点影响检查与用药，不是所有病例都属于隐球菌感染。
- 除肠道病毒和腺病毒外，疱疹病毒、西尼罗等虫媒病毒、流感或HIV等也可累及脑膜；传播方式不同，不能据“病毒性”就判断需要哪种接触者措施。
- 寄生虫性脑膜炎可与吃进被污染的食物或动物粪便有关，通常不在人与人之间传播；来源与旅行地区因虫种而异，不能把所有病例当作游泳水进入鼻子造成的阿米巴感染。
text.en:
Different pathogens have different routes of entry and susceptible groups. Medicines, autoimmune disease or cancer can also cause noninfectious meningitis.

- Some bacteria spread through close contact with respiratory secretions or saliva, such as kissing; carriers may have no symptoms.
- Contacts of a person with viral meningitis may acquire the same virus, but most will not develop meningitis.
- Newborns, people with weakened immunity, absent or poorly functioning spleens, and some group-living populations have higher risks of particular bacterial infections; the likely bacteria differ between groups.
- Fungal meningitis generally does not spread between people and is more likely in those with weakened immunity.
- Enteroviruses are a group of viruses spread through infected stool, saliva or respiratory secretions, and contaminated hands or objects. Having an enterovirus infection does not mean that meningitis will necessarily develop.
- Streptococci include different bacteria: group B organisms are prominent in newborns, while pneumococcus also affects older children and adults. Staphylococci and some gram-negative bacteria require attention to head injury, neurosurgery, shunts and other infection sources.
- Adenovirus usually affects the respiratory tract, eyes or gut but can occasionally involve the nervous system; immunocompromised people face greater severity. Respiratory symptoms or diarrhoea do not rule out meningitis.
- Fungi can rarely enter through contaminated spinal injections or procedures, including in otherwise healthy people. Symptoms may develop slowly. Species and exposure location affect investigation and treatment; not every case is cryptococcal.
- Beyond enterovirus and adenovirus, herpesviruses, arboviruses such as West Nile, influenza and HIV can affect the meninges. Transmission differs, so the label viral alone does not determine contact precautions.
- Parasitic meningitis may follow ingestion of contaminated food or animal faeces and generally does not spread between people. Exposure and travel risks depend on the organism; not every case is amoebic infection from water entering the nose.

text.zh-CN:
疑似脑膜炎需要立即医疗评估，不等出疹、发热或所有症状齐全。

- 新出现意识混乱、抽搐或难以唤醒，应立即呼叫当地急救电话或去急诊；即使没有发热也按此行动。
- 非常剧烈的头痛，或颈部僵硬并且看亮光疼痛，需要立即急诊评估。按压不褪色的紫红色皮疹也是危险信号；没有皮疹不能排除脑膜炎。
- 婴儿或幼儿出现反应差、身体松软、难唤醒、持续异常尖哭或头顶软处鼓起，尤其同时不肯吃奶时，应立即急诊评估。这些表现不要求同时出现。
text.en:
Suspected meningitis needs immediate medical assessment; do not wait for a rash, fever or every symptom.

- New confusion, seizures or difficulty waking require an immediate call to local emergency services or emergency care, even without fever.
- A very severe headache, or neck stiffness with pain on looking at bright light, needs immediate emergency assessment. A purple-red rash that does not fade under pressure is another warning sign; its absence does not exclude meningitis.
- An infant or young child who is poorly responsive, floppy, hard to wake, crying unusually and persistently, or has a bulging soft spot on the head needs immediate emergency assessment, especially with feeding refusal. These signs need not occur together.

text.zh-CN:
尚未确诊、出现脑膜炎危险信号时，按上方急救行动处理；不要先把它当成普通头痛在家观察。

- 就诊准备提示：把症状开始时间、近期旅行或患者接触、接种记录、正在用的药和药物过敏告诉医疗团队；可由熟悉情况的亲友协助说明。这是帮助沟通的清单，不是诊断评分。
- 轻症病毒性病例可在医生评估后居家恢复；是否能回家取决于病情，而不是自己猜测病原体。
- 居家期间若持续呕吐、连少量水也喝不下或喝了就吐，现在联系医生或急诊分诊服务，不能继续只靠喝水观察；伴意识变化或剧烈头痛时直接急诊。
- 孩子喝不够水且越来越不舒服，或婴儿生病时拒绝吃奶、喝水，应现在联系医疗服务；出现身体松软、难唤醒或反应异常，按急救处理。
text.en:
Before diagnosis, meningitis warning signs require the emergency action above rather than a period of home observation for an ordinary headache.

- Visit preparation: tell the team when symptoms began, recent travel or ill contacts, vaccination history, current medicines and medicine allergies; a relative or friend who knows the situation can help. This is a communication checklist, not a diagnostic score.
- Mild viral cases may recover at home after clinical assessment; discharge depends on illness severity, not a guess about the pathogen.
- During home recovery, ongoing vomiting with inability to drink even small amounts or keep water down requires contacting a clinician or urgent assessment service now; fluids alone are no longer enough. Altered awareness or severe headache requires emergency care.
- If a child cannot drink enough and is getting sicker, or an ill infant refuses nursing or fluids, contact a medical service now. Floppiness, difficulty waking or abnormal responsiveness requires emergency care.

text.zh-CN:
检查的目标是确认是否存在脑膜炎并寻找病因，医生会结合病史、身体检查和检验结果判断。

- 腰椎穿刺是从腰部取少量脑脊液；脑脊液是包围脑和脊髓的液体。检测细胞数量、糖和蛋白质，并检查病原体，可帮助区分病因。
- 血培养是观察血液样本能否长出细菌；PCR等分子检测寻找病原体的遗传物质。单一血液指标正常，仍不能独自排除细菌性脑膜炎。
- 部分患者需先稳定呼吸或循环，或因意识、神经检查异常而做脑部影像。医生评估腰穿是否安全；怀疑急性细菌性脑膜炎时，不能为了等影像、腰穿或结果而延误抗生素。
- 怀疑肠道病毒性脑膜炎时，医生可对脑脊液做PCR等检查来寻找病毒。流感嗜血杆菌感染可用培养或PCR等检测确认；进一步分清是否为Hib，有助公共卫生团队决定接触者措施。
- 对术后、持续或反复的脑膜炎，医生可能需要复查脑脊液、培养和影像，寻找病原体、感染装置或结构问题。用过抗生素会降低部分检查检出率，单次阴性不能独自排除感染。
- 怀疑寄生虫时，旅行、吃过的生食和动物粪便接触很重要；脑脊液、影像等检查可提供线索，但直接找到寄生虫并不容易。不同寄生虫的检查不能互相替代。
text.en:
The aim is to establish whether meningitis is present and identify its cause, using the history, examination and test results together.

- Lumbar puncture takes a small sample of cerebrospinal fluid from the lower back; this is the fluid surrounding the brain and spinal cord. Cell counts, sugar, protein and pathogen tests help distinguish causes.
- Blood culture checks whether bacteria grow from a blood sample; molecular tests such as PCR look for pathogen genetic material. A single normal blood marker cannot by itself rule out bacterial meningitis.
- Some patients need breathing or circulation stabilised first, or brain imaging because of abnormal consciousness or neurological findings. Clinicians assess whether lumbar puncture is safe; suspected acute bacterial meningitis must not have antibiotics delayed while awaiting imaging, lumbar puncture or results.
- When enteroviral meningitis is suspected, clinicians may use PCR and other tests on cerebrospinal fluid to look for the virus. Culture or PCR can identify H. influenzae infection; determining whether it is Hib helps public-health teams decide contact measures.
- After surgery or with persistent or recurrent meningitis, repeat CSF testing, cultures and imaging may identify organisms, infected devices or structural problems. Prior antibiotics can reduce detection; a single negative result does not exclude infection.
- When parasites are suspected, travel, raw food and animal-faeces exposure matter. CSF and imaging can provide clues, but finding the organism can be difficult; tests for different parasites are not interchangeable.

text.zh-CN:
早期脑膜炎可能像流感或胃肠炎，出现发热、呕吐和全身不适；症状重叠是需要检查的原因。

- 偏头痛也可引起怕光、恶心、呕吐，甚至颈部不适。熟悉的偏头痛病史可帮助医生判断，但这些症状本身不能区分偏头痛与脑膜炎。
- 突然极重的头痛，或头痛伴新出现的抽搐、意识混乱、难唤醒，都需要急诊排查感染、出血或其他脑部急症；有偏头痛病史也一样。
- 脑膜炎不等于脑膜炎球菌病：多种病原体会引起脑膜炎；脑膜炎球菌也能进入血液，造成没有脑膜炎的血流感染和脓毒症。
- “良性复发性脑膜炎”不是反复头痛的自我诊断。部分复发与HSV-2相关；反复细菌感染还可能涉及脑脊液漏或免疫问题，药物和非感染性疾病也会造成复发表现。
text.en:
Early meningitis may resemble flu or gastroenteritis, with fever, vomiting and feeling unwell; this overlap is why assessment is needed.

- Migraine can also cause light sensitivity, nausea, vomiting and even neck discomfort. A familiar migraine history helps clinical assessment, but those symptoms alone do not distinguish migraine from meningitis.
- A sudden extremely severe headache, or headache with a new seizure, confusion or difficulty waking, needs emergency assessment for infection, bleeding or another brain emergency, even with a history of migraine.
- Meningitis is not synonymous with meningococcal disease: many pathogens cause meningitis, while meningococci can enter the blood and cause bloodstream infection and sepsis without meningitis.
- Benign recurrent meningitis is not a self-diagnosis for repeated headaches. Some recurrences involve HSV-2; recurrent bacterial infection may reflect a CSF leak or immune problem, while medicines and noninfectious disease can also produce recurrent episodes.

text.zh-CN:
治疗先处理可能迅速危及生命的情况，再按查明的病因调整。不同类型不能使用同一套疗程。

- 急性细菌性脑膜炎通常需要住院，尽快通过静脉给予抗生素；病原体尚未确定时先覆盖常见细菌，再按检查结果调整。
- 呼吸、循环或抽搐出现问题时，医院还会给予相应支持，例如需要时供氧、静脉补液和控制抽搐。处理这些问题与抗感染同时进行。
- 多数轻症病毒性病例以休息、补充液体和缓解疼痛发热为主；有严重病情或免疫功能低下等情况，可能仍需住院。
- 真菌性脑膜炎需要抗真菌药，具体药物和疗程取决于真菌种类及免疫状态，不按轻症病毒性病例处理。
- 结核性脑膜炎由结核分枝杆菌引起，需要结核专科制定多药联合治疗。它不属于WHO急性脑膜炎指南所覆盖的常规急性病原体范围，也不能照搬普通肺结核或轻症病毒性脑膜炎的疗程。
- 对已经查明的肠道病毒性脑膜炎，治疗通常以缓解症状和支持恢复为主，没有常规用于清除肠道病毒的特效药；这不表示尚未检查的人可以在家等待。
- 流感嗜血杆菌性脑膜炎属于细菌性脑膜炎。
- 术后或分流管相关感染的抗生素选择与普通社区病例不同，需要考虑耐药菌和药物进入脑脊液的能力；确诊病原体后按药敏调整。感染装置可能还需由神经外科处理。
- 腺病毒性脑膜炎按神经系统病情接受监护和支持治疗，不能把普通腺病毒感冒的居家建议直接照搬。目前没有普遍适用的获批腺病毒特效药；重症或移植患者的特殊用药由专科决定。
- 梅毒螺旋体也能累及脑膜，可能伴视力、听力或神经功能改变；需要神经梅毒方案，通常使用静脉青霉素，不能用一般病毒性脑膜炎的休息方案替代。
text.en:
Treatment first addresses immediately dangerous illness and is then adjusted to the identified cause. Different types do not share one treatment course.

- Acute bacterial meningitis usually requires hospital care and prompt intravenous antibiotics. Before the pathogen is known, treatment covers likely bacteria and is adjusted to test results.
- Breathing, circulation or seizure problems also need hospital support, such as oxygen when needed, intravenous fluids and seizure treatment, alongside treatment of the infection.
- Most mild viral cases are managed with rest, fluids and relief of pain and fever; severe illness or weakened immunity may still require hospital care.
- Fungal meningitis needs antifungal medicines; the fungus and immune status determine the drugs and duration, rather than the approach for mild viral illness.
- Tuberculous meningitis is caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis and requires a TB specialist’s multidrug regimen. It is outside the routine acute pathogens covered by the WHO acute meningitis guideline, and treatment courses for uncomplicated pulmonary TB or mild viral meningitis cannot simply be copied.
- For established enteroviral meningitis, treatment is usually supportive and relieves symptoms; there is no routine medicine that specifically clears enteroviruses. This does not mean that someone who has not been assessed should wait at home.
- H. influenzae meningitis is a form of bacterial meningitis.
- Postoperative or shunt-associated infection requires different antibiotic choices from community cases, accounting for resistance and CSF penetration. Treatment is refined using susceptibility results; infected hardware may also require neurosurgical management.
- Adenoviral meningitis requires monitoring and support according to neurological severity; ordinary adenovirus cold advice cannot simply be applied at home. There is no generally applicable approved specific antiviral; specialists decide exceptional treatment in severe or transplant cases.
- Syphilis can involve the meninges with visual, hearing or neurological changes. It requires a neurosyphilis regimen, usually intravenous penicillin, rather than rest alone as for uncomplicated viral illness.

text.zh-CN:
抗感染药针对不同病原体；医生还会考虑年龄、免疫状态、当地耐药情况和药物过敏。

- 抗生素能治疗细菌感染，不能清除引起病毒性脑膜炎的病毒；疱疹病毒等特定病因可能使用抗病毒药。
- 糖皮质激素是减轻炎症的辅助药，不替代抗生素。WHO建议在非流行期的适用急性细菌性病例中，与首剂抗生素一起开始；NICE对年龄和病原体另作规定，由医院决定，不能自行套用到所有脑膜炎。
- 抗生素偶可引起严重过敏。用药后出现呼吸困难、口唇舌头或喉咙肿胀，要立即呼叫急救；在医院内立即告知医护，不能等下一次常规复诊。
- 抗结核药需要留意不良反应：出现眼睛或皮肤发黄、视力改变等情况，联系治疗团队进行评估；医生据具体药物决定检查和是否调整治疗。
- 抗真菌治疗可用静脉药并衔接口服药，但具体种类和疗程差异很大；某些注射相关霉菌感染可能使用伏立康唑，证据和预后仍有不确定性。不能将一种真菌的药单用于另一种。
- 已确诊HSV相关脑膜炎可使用阿昔洛韦等抗病毒药；脑炎是脑组织受累，治疗路径可能更长。复发者是否口服、是否需要预防性长期用药，应结合既往病原证据和本次严重程度讨论，不能照抄生殖器疱疹处方。
- 寄生虫种类决定能否使用驱虫药或抗炎药，不能统一“驱虫加激素”。例如颚口线虫累及神经系统时，这些药的获益尚不确定，治疗还可能加重神经损伤；由感染与神经专科权衡，不能照皮肤寄生虫感染处方自行服药。
text.en:
Anti-infective medicines target different pathogens; clinicians also consider age, immune status, local resistance and medicine allergies.

- Antibiotics treat bacterial infection but do not clear the viruses causing viral meningitis; selected causes such as herpesviruses may be treated with antivirals.
- Corticosteroids are adjuncts that reduce inflammation, not replacements for antibiotics. WHO recommends starting them with the first antibiotic dose in eligible acute bacterial cases outside epidemics; NICE adds age- and pathogen-specific rules. The hospital decides rather than applying steroids to every meningitis case.
- Antibiotics can occasionally cause severe allergy. Trouble breathing or swelling of the lips, tongue or throat after a dose requires emergency help immediately; in hospital alert staff at once, rather than waiting for routine follow-up.
- Anti-TB medicines need adverse-effect surveillance: yellowing of the eyes or skin, or changes in vision, should be reported to the treatment team for assessment; the specific drug determines tests and treatment changes.
- Antifungal care may combine intravenous and later oral treatment, with substantial differences in agent and duration. Voriconazole may be used for certain injection-associated mould infections, with uncertainty in evidence and prognosis. Regimens cannot be transferred between fungal species.
- Confirmed HSV meningitis may be treated with antivirals such as acyclovir. Encephalitis involves brain tissue and can require longer treatment. Oral treatment and long-term prevention for recurrences depend on prior organism evidence and current severity, rather than copying genital-herpes prescriptions.
- Antiparasitic and anti-inflammatory treatment depends on the organism; deworming plus steroids is not universal. In neurological Gnathostoma infection, benefits remain uncertain and treatment may worsen neurological injury. Infectious-disease and neurological specialists weigh the options; skin-infection prescriptions are not for self-treatment.

text.zh-CN:
饮食的作用是维持营养和水分，以及减少某些食源性感染；食物本身不能代替针对病原体的治疗。

- 医生同意在家恢复的轻症病毒性病例，可按耐受情况喝水、进食；恶心时尝试少量多次。若连少量水也留不住，按“何时就医”的即时联系安排处理。
- 孕妇、老年人和免疫功能低下者尤其要减少李斯特菌暴露：选择巴氏消毒奶，避免生奶和生奶制品。巴氏消毒是通过加热减少有害细菌的处理。
- 奶酪要分类型：用巴氏消毒奶制成的硬奶酪通常是较安全的选择；queso fresco、queso blanco、requesón这类鲜软奶酪，即使用巴氏消毒奶制作，也应避免未加热食用。
- 熟食冷切肉、热狗等也不是开包就一定安全；上述易感人群食用前应重新加热到整体热透、冒蒸汽。冷藏不能可靠消除李斯特菌。
- 在相关流行地区或旅行时，避免生吃或未煮熟的淡水鱼、蛙类及禽肉，可减少颚口线虫等食源性寄生虫感染；进食史应告诉医生，但没有想起某次生食也不能独自排除感染。
text.en:
Food and fluids support nutrition and hydration, and safer food choices reduce some foodborne infections; food itself does not replace treatment directed at the pathogen.

- For mild viral illness cleared for home recovery, drink and eat as tolerated, trying small amounts when nauseated. If even small amounts of water cannot be retained, use the immediate medical-contact advice under “When to seek care”.
- Pregnant people, older adults and people with weakened immunity especially need to reduce Listeria exposure: choose pasteurized milk and avoid raw milk and raw-milk products. Pasteurization uses heat to reduce harmful bacteria.
- Cheese type matters: hard cheese made with pasteurized milk is generally a safer choice; queso fresco-type fresh soft cheeses, including queso blanco and requesón, should not be eaten unheated even when made with pasteurized milk.
- Ready-to-eat deli meats and hot dogs are not automatically safe straight from the packet; people in the groups above should reheat them until steaming hot throughout. Refrigeration does not reliably eliminate Listeria.
- In relevant endemic areas or during travel, avoiding raw or undercooked freshwater fish, frogs and poultry reduces foodborne parasite exposure such as Gnathostoma. Tell the clinician about foods eaten; failure to recall one exposure alone does not rule out infection.

text.zh-CN:
家庭照护适用于已经接受评估并获准回家的人；有急救信号时重新求助。

- 按出院安排休息和使用缓解症状的药物。可简单记下头痛是否加重、喝水和呕吐情况、清醒程度，方便向医护说明变化；这不是在家排除脑膜炎的评分表。
- 认真洗手，不共用杯子、餐具等接触唾液的物品，可减少相关病原体传播；具体隔离和接触者处理由病因决定。
- 离院前把后续就诊地点、联系人和听力评估安排记清楚；若出院后出现新的难唤醒、抽搐或意识混乱，不等预约日期，立即急救。
text.en:
Home care applies to people assessed and cleared to go home; seek help again if emergency signs develop.

- Follow the discharge plan for rest and symptom medicines. A simple note of worsening headache, drinking/vomiting and alertness can help you describe changes to staff; it is not a home score for ruling out meningitis.
- Wash hands carefully and avoid sharing cups or cutlery that contact saliva to reduce spread of relevant pathogens; the cause determines isolation and contact management.
- Before leaving, note the follow-up location, contact person and hearing-assessment arrangements. New difficulty waking, seizures or confusion after discharge require emergency help without waiting for the appointment.

text.zh-CN:
年龄和免疫状态会改变常见病原体、症状表达与处理方式。

- 婴儿可能没有典型颈部僵硬，也无法诉说头痛，反而表现为吃奶差、异常哭声、反应变差或头顶软处鼓起。新生儿需要按新生儿感染路径评估，不能直接套用较大儿童或成人的方案。
- 化疗、移植后用药或HIV等造成免疫功能低下时，真菌感染等病因更值得考虑；把这些情况告知团队，有助选择针对性的检查和治疗。
- 妊娠会增加李斯特菌感染风险；母亲症状可能较轻，但感染可影响胎儿或新生儿。就医时说明妊娠情况，并按本页食安建议选择食物。
- 肠道病毒感染在婴幼儿和儿童中较常见，月龄很小的婴儿更容易出现严重病情。
text.en:
Age and immune status change the likely pathogens, how symptoms are expressed and the care needed.

- Infants may lack classic neck stiffness and cannot describe headache; poor feeding, an unusual cry, reduced responsiveness or a bulging soft spot may be the clues. Newborns need a neonatal-infection assessment rather than direct use of an older-child or adult regimen.
- Chemotherapy, transplant medicines or HIV can weaken immunity and make causes such as fungal infection more relevant; tell the team about them to guide targeted testing and treatment.
- Pregnancy raises Listeria risk; maternal symptoms can be mild while infection harms the fetus or newborn. Tell the team about pregnancy and use the food-safety advice on this page.
- Enterovirus infection is common in infants and children, and very young babies are more vulnerable to severe illness.

text.zh-CN:
预后取决于病因、治疗时机及是否出现神经并发症。

- 多数轻症病毒性病例可逐渐恢复；细菌性、结核性和真菌性不能沿用同一恢复时间表。真菌性病例的疗程还与免疫状态有关。
- 听力检查要主动安排，尤其细菌性脑膜炎之后，不能等到本人或家长察觉听不清才检查。正式听力评估由听力专业人员完成，不是只在家试声音。
- 时间按适用指南核对：WHO对其急性社区获得性脑膜炎范围内的超过1月龄的儿童和成人，建议出院前正式听力筛查，不能完成时在出院后4周内完成；英国NICE针对细菌性脑膜炎或脑膜炎球菌病，建议身体状况允许测试后4周内完成，最好出院前。两个起算点不同。
- WHO把及时听力筛查列为强建议，但证据确定性很低，主要依据间接证据和专家判断；这不等于精确时点已由高质量对照试验证实。
- 复诊还应关注视力、记忆学习、活动和心理状态，出现困难时安排相应评估与康复；新出现意识混乱、抽搐或难唤醒按急救处理。
- 复发后的随访重点是核对每次检查结果、是否同一病因以及是否存在结构或免疫问题；“上次自己好了”不能替代本次评估。重新出现本页危险信号仍按急救处理。
- 神经系统寄生虫感染可能留下功能损伤，也可能在治疗后复发；随访要报告重新出现的头痛、无力、皮肤游走肿块或其他神经变化，严重或突然变化按本页急救行动处理。
text.en:
Outcome depends on cause, treatment timing and neurological complications.

- Most mild viral cases recover gradually; bacterial, tuberculous and fungal disease do not share one recovery timeline. Immune status also affects the duration of antifungal treatment.
- Hearing assessment should be planned proactively, especially after bacterial meningitis, rather than waiting for the person or family to notice hearing loss. Formal audiological assessment is a professional test, not only a home sound check.
- Check the applicable timing: for children over 1 month and adults within its acute community-acquired meningitis scope, WHO recommends formal hearing screening before discharge, or within 4 weeks after discharge if that is not possible. UK NICE recommends assessment after bacterial meningitis or meningococcal disease within 4 weeks of being well enough for testing, preferably before discharge. These are different starting points.
- WHO makes a strong recommendation for timely hearing screening despite very low certainty of evidence, relying mainly on indirect evidence and expert judgement; this does not mean the exact timing has been established by high-quality comparative trials.
- Follow-up also considers vision, memory/learning, movement and psychological wellbeing, with assessment and rehabilitation for difficulties; new confusion, seizures or difficulty waking require emergency care.
- Follow-up after recurrence reviews each episode’s results, whether the cause is the same, and possible structural or immune problems. Spontaneous recovery last time does not replace reassessment; new warning signs still require the emergency actions above.
- Neurological parasitic infection can leave functional impairment or recur after treatment. Report returning headache, weakness, migratory skin swelling or other neurological changes at follow-up; severe or sudden changes require the emergency actions above.

text.zh-CN:
并发症既可能发生在急性期，也可能在感染控制后才显现。

- 急性期可出现抽搐、脑功能受损、脓毒症或休克，严重时危及生命；及时治疗有助降低风险。
- 部分患者留有听力或视力下降、记忆学习困难、肢体无力等后遗症；并非所有患者都会发生，实际变化决定需要哪些支持。
- 颚口线虫等寄生虫可同时损伤神经组织，造成无力、瘫痪或颅内出血；这与单纯皮肤游走肿块的治疗情境不同。
text.en:
Complications can occur during the acute illness or become apparent after infection is controlled.

- Acute seizures, brain dysfunction, sepsis or shock can be life-threatening; prompt treatment helps reduce risk.
- Some survivors have hearing or vision loss, memory/learning difficulties or limb weakness; these do not affect everyone, and actual changes determine support needs.
- Parasites such as Gnathostoma may injure nervous tissue, causing weakness, paralysis or intracranial bleeding. This differs from the treatment setting of migratory skin swelling alone.

text.zh-CN:
预防按病原体进行，没有一种疫苗能覆盖全部脑膜炎。

- 脑膜炎球菌、肺炎球菌和Hib疫苗可预防部分细菌性病例；Hib是可引起严重感染的一种细菌，不是流感病毒。
- 接种年龄、补种、旅行或暴发时的额外接种，应按所在地公共卫生部门安排核对。本页WHO的疫苗范围、英国NHS和美国CDC的建议各有适用背景，不能把某国接种时间直接用于其他国家。
- 脑膜炎球菌病的密切接触者可能需预防抗生素，即使接种过也应接受接触评估；是否需要由医生或公共卫生团队确定。
- 上述接触者用药针对脑膜炎球菌，不是所有脑膜炎都要让家人服抗生素；病毒和真菌的传播及预防措施不同。
- 针对肠道病毒，换尿布或如厕后认真用肥皂和水洗手，清洁经常接触的物品表面，可帮助减少传播。
- 确诊Hib侵袭性感染后，家人等接触者也可能需要预防抗生素，应由治疗团队或当地公共卫生人员评估。英国和美国的具体适用条件不同；不能把这一措施套用于所有流感嗜血杆菌类型，也不要自行给全家用药。
- 腺病毒可通过手、物品、咳嗽和粪便传播。照护时认真洗手，特别是换尿布之后；一般公众没有常规可用的腺病毒疫苗，不能把军队特定疫苗当成儿童接种项目。
text.en:
Prevention is pathogen-specific; no single vaccine covers every form of meningitis.

- Meningococcal, pneumococcal and Hib vaccines prevent some bacterial cases; Hib is a bacterium that can cause serious infection, not the influenza virus.
- Check local public-health schedules for routine ages, catch-up doses and additional travel or outbreak vaccination. WHO’s vaccine scope and UK NHS and US CDC advice have their own settings; one country’s timing should not be copied directly into another.
- Close contacts of meningococcal disease may need preventive antibiotics and exposure assessment even if vaccinated; a clinician or public-health team determines who needs them.
- That contact medicine is directed at meningococci; not every meningitis case requires antibiotics for family members, because viral and fungal transmission and prevention differ.
- For enteroviruses, washing hands carefully with soap and water after changing nappies or using the toilet, and cleaning frequently touched surfaces, can help reduce spread.
- After confirmed invasive Hib disease, family members and other contacts may also need preventive antibiotics, as assessed by the treating team or local public-health service. UK and US eligibility rules differ; this measure must not be applied to every H. influenzae type, and families should not self-medicate.
- Adenovirus spreads through hands, objects, coughing and stool. Wash hands carefully during care, especially after diaper changes. There is no routinely available adenovirus vaccine for the general public; military-specific vaccines are not a childhood schedule.

limitations.zh-CN: 各节保留来源定位和地区条件；编辑证据记录中的未完成项见来源与编辑信息。
limitations.en: Section sources and regional conditions are retained; unfinished evidence checks are recorded in editorial information.
